family.description: This domain of unknown function is found in fungal proteins including Mug8 from Schizosaccharomyces pombe which may have a role in meiosis and septation [[cite:PUB00044889]]. Saccharomyces cerevisiae homologue MSB1 (swiss:P21339) may be involved in positive regulation of 1,3-beta-glucan synthesis and the Pkc1p-MAPK pathway [[cite:PUB00087082]].
family.name: Meiotically up-regulated protein Msb1/Mug8 domain
